scripts.build: pnpm --filter @orange-monitor/protocol build && pnpm --filter @orange-monitor/sdk-core build && pnpm --filter @orange-monitor/collector-api build && pnpm --filter @orange-monitor/monitor-web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @orange-monitor/protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @orange-monitor/sdk-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @orange-monitor/collector-api typecheck && pnpm --filter @orange-monitor/monitor-web typecheck
scripts.release:pack: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('.artifacts', { recursive: true })" && pnpm --filter @orange-monitor/protocol pack --pack-destination ./.artifacts && pnpm --filter @orange-monitor/sdk-core pack --pack-destination ./.artifacts
scripts.release:publish: pnpm --filter @orange-monitor/protocol publish --access public && pnpm --filter @orange-monitor/sdk-core publish --access public
